review_note: Contained industrial-market and ERP implementation pressure was reported, with the implementation difficulty described as resolved; Group margin improved 30bps, free cash flow remained robust though 7% lower, and revenue, earnings, margins and balance-sheet evidence supplied multiple quantified contrary indicators.

Specific supply-chain, labour and inflation pressure was contained by pricing and operational response; adjusted margin improved 270bps, free-cash-flow conversion reached 103%, leverage was 1.1x, and revenue and earnings growth supplied multiple quantified contrary indicators.

Facility upgrades, relocations and efficiency work were growth-supporting rather than pressure-led; adjusted margin improved 80bps, free-cash-flow conversion was 100%, leverage fell to 0.9x, and organic revenue and earnings growth supplied multiple strong quantified contrary indicators.
